summary: Dependent Type Semantics (Bekki): @-slots rendered as resolution spaces Ctx -> A with felicity = inhabitedness (type checking succeeds); the donkey conditional whose canonical projection-resolution recovers Ranta's donkey_sentence definitionally — DTS resolution generalizes the pronominalization rule; the strong reading inherited through the bridge; ambiguity = extensionally distinct resolvents (two-antecedent discourse over bool); presupposition as @-terms: bare 'the farmer talks' demands a witness (felicitous unit Farmer equivalent to Farmer), while inside the donkey conditional the definite resolves locally from the antecedent and the conditional projects nothing (context passing).
